evidence.field: baxter-sagart.tsv rows for 書 and 者; MC and OC columns
evidence.text: The exact supplied rows are 書: MC syo, OC *s-ta, gloss “write”; 者: MC tsyaeX, OC *tAʔ, gloss “nominalizing particle.” These are distinct Middle Chinese and Old Chinese reconstructions within Baxter–Sagart 2014. The Old Chinese initials differ (*s- versus *t-), so the rows do not support the prior claim that both share *t-. They document the readings but do not, by themselves, explain why 說文 assigns 者 the phonetic role in 書.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

search_audit.query: 書 者 Baxter Sagart 2014 Old Chinese *s-ta *tAʔ phonetic
search_audit.outcome: Search executed. Oxford describes the reconstruction work and system; the dataset PDF open failed, so the character-specific values used here are the supplied exact local rows, preserved as provided. The Old Chinese pair has differing initials and does not independently establish the historical phonetic correspondence.
Inspected both exact Commons descriptions, confirming labels, source-image identifiers, and public-domain representation terms. The bronze direct-image fetch returned a cache miss.

search_audit.query: 書-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons original file public domain
search_audit.outcome: Inspected 書 and 者 Commons description pages. The exact 聿 page returned an internal error; the 書 seal Original file link was confirmed on the description page, but SVG payload retrieval failed due unsupported content type. No direct image URL was accepted as successfully retrieved.

gaps: The matched local Baxter–Sagart rows give 書 MC syo / OC *s-ta and 者 MC tsyaeX / OC *tAʔ. Their Old Chinese initials differ, and the supplied rows alone do not show the historical phonological development underlying the traditional phonetic analysis. Avoid saying the Old Chinese initials are the same or overstating the correspondence.

No usable candidate image was successfully retrieved during this pass. Commons verifies direct links and public-domain reuse for the 書 seal and bronze redraws, but the seal SVG returned an unsupported-content error and the bronze SVG returned a cache miss. Their description pages alone do not establish independent dating; especially, the bronze page marks the period as needing specification.
No new primary paleographic evidence on the earliest attestation, graphic sequence, or semantic chronology was found in this bounded review-resolution pass.
